note: A repeated alert or a missed one can happen on a free model: open the PR before acting on an alert. After the runs, the live graders were changed to accept a PR's files marked as not read when the files call failed; that changed no result.

limits: OpenRouter free models: 50 requests a day with no credits, 1,000 a day after a one-time $10, 20 a minute
GitHub's anonymous API: 60 requests an hour per IP address; this template spends 1 a check, plus 1 or 2 per new PR
Free endpoints may log prompts, and NVIDIA's free endpoint is not on OpenRouter's zero-retention list: public repositories only
